entries.title: Galatians 3:3
segments: Having begun in the Spirit, are ye now perfected in the flesh? The Galatians were not turning away from Christianity, but seeking to perfect themselves therein by observing the Jewish laws and customs.  Compare

entries.title: Galatians 3:5
segments: Worketh miracles among you. See

entries.title: Galatians 3:6
segments: Abraham believed God. Salvation through faith is the teaching of the Old testament as well as of the New.  But the faith required then, as now, is one of the vital kind which is perfected in obedience and expressed in works. See

entries.title: Galatians 3:7
segments: Sons of Abraham. In the spiritual sense those who receive the faith are Abraham's sons, whether Jews or Gentiles.

entries.title: Galatians 3:8
segments: In thee shall all the nations be blessed. See
.  Jesus Christ, of the seed of Abraham, brought salvation not only to the Jews, but to the whole world.

entries.title: Galatians 3:10
segments: Cursed is every one who continueth not, etc.  This is the concluding paragraph of the condemnation under the law pronounced by the Levites from Mount Ebal (
). The law demanded entire obedience.  He who violated one commandment was guilty of all (
).  Since no man is perfect, he who abides under the law and does not keep all, abides under the curse.  Justification is by faith through obedience.

entries.title: Galatians 3:12
segments: Shall live in them. 'In them' in the sense of 'by means of them.'

entries.title: Galatians 3:13
segments: Having become a curse for us. Jesus came under the law and in his death paid the penalty of the law.  Like the symbolic scape-goat (
), he was the representative of the sin and the curse which it entailed.

entries.title: Galatians 3:14
segments: Receive the promise of the Spirit through faith. Faith is the only channel through which the promised gift of the Spirit can be received.

entries.title: Galatians 3:16
segments: To Abraham were the promises spoken. See

entries.title: Galatians 3:17
segments: Confirmed beforehand by God. 'He is faithful that promised' (

entries.title: Galatians 3:18
segments: For if the inheritance is of the law. An inheritance founded on the law would fail through failure to keep the law.  It is saved by faith in the promises and in Christ as the fulfilment of the promises.

entries.title: Galatians 3:19
segments: What then is the law?  It was added because of transgressions. 'The law made nothing perfect' (
), but is a guide leading unto Christ (
), who 'having been made perfect, he became unto all them that obey him the author of eternal salvation' (

).
 

 
 Till the seed should come. The iniquities of the unrighteous extended to the third and fourth generations (

).
 

 
 Ordained through angels. See

entries.title: Galatians 3:20
segments: A mediator is not a mediator of one. The offices of a mediator are needed only when the parties are divided. There was no mediator between God and Abraham; there is no mediator between Christ and the believer.

entries.title: Galatians 3:21
segments: Is the law then against the promises? The law of Moses ended in the higher law of the gospel.  For Christ became 'the mediator of a better covenant' (
).  See also

entries.title: Galatians 3:23
segments: Shut up unto the faith. In bondage under the law, in the absence of the higher motive power of faith, until released by righteousness through faith.

entries.title: Galatians 3:24
segments: The law is become our tutor. See
